map.name: The Verdigris Archive
map.description: A quiet chamber puzzle about restoring a sealed archive.

text.objectives: Find three archive keys in order, then reach the observatory exit.
briefing: Guide the selected scholar through the hub and three marked chambers.
Each chamber records one key only when entered in order.
The observatory door opens after all three keys; reach it before the clock expires.

messages.start: Three archive chambers are sealed. Follow their symbols in order.
messages.seal_1: First glyph restored. The eastern archive is next.
messages.seal_2: Second glyph restored. Descend to the southern archive.
messages.seal_3: Final glyph restored. The observatory exit is open.
messages.timeout: The archive seals before the observatory is reached.
